name: Crime Mob
notes: Piano-riff crunk: the defining element is a **monophonic minor piano riff in the mid register**, so the melody block is the most tightly constrained in this batch — `register` [58, 74] is the research's rough C4–C5 with a little air either side, `octaveJumpProb` drops to 0.03 because a mono riff does not jump octaves, and `densityPerBar` rises to 3–7 while every other early-crunk entry here sits at 1–5. `halfStepDissonance` is 0.14 and the scale weighting leads with harmonic minor, which is where the research's Phrygian/harmonic-minor piano figures come from. ⛔ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set for the reason the research gives explicitly: the ♭VI–V motion is *implied by a single-line riff rather than chords*. The families below exist so the chord part has something to voice, and the two-chord ones carry the implied motion rather than stating a progression the record plays. Its variety comes from `chordDurationBeats` [2, 12] and three `harmonicRhythm` values. ⚠ The research says the countermelody is **absent**. It is authored here at the engine's floor — `densityRatio` 0.30, two styles — rather than removed, because a counter thinner than that saturates and a model that omits the block inherits the genre's much busier one. Treat the counter as the pad-and-answer layer of the hook rather than as a part the record has. ⚠ `confidence` is medium and the inferred parameters are the numbers: the research documents the piano-led template and the era, and marks the tempo band [LOW-CONF]. ⚠ Fill fingerprint for this batch: `gapProb` 0.56 / `descendProb` 0.08 / `rampJitter` 11. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 970 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: densityRatio 0.45. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
